body.name: Universal signed-cell lift
body.construction: Given \(h\in\ker(A_P)\), form \(r^h\), choose positive \(\rho_x\), set \(d^h_{s,a}=\rho_x(r^h_a-r^h_{a_s})/C_x\), apply the fixed anchor-specific support-tangent map \(\Gamma_{s,x,u,w,a_s}\), set \(\Delta^h=\Gamma_{s,x,u,w,a_s}(d^h)\) on the positive support of \(K\), and replace \(K\) by \(K+\varepsilon\Delta^h\) for \(|\varepsilon|<\varepsilon_*(h)\).
